decisions.reason: The peak-alignment decision does not change the second V hierarchy; the independent second-V clause in the same message is already fully represented by its existing MODIFY.
Aligning the absolute peaks changes positional composition, not the shared terminal gesture, terminal construction, or evaluation rule.
The accent remains literally derived from the Hero V terminal; the source adds a separate peak-positioning rule without changing its derivation geometry.
The peak-alignment refinement does not alter the second V's glyph geometry or right-arm derivation; its separate height hierarchy is owned by another Requirement.
The relational peak-alignment rule does not necessarily modify the Hero V geometry; the source does not specify changing any Hero V attribute.
Using the E and L as reference heights for the second V does not change their architectural construction, originality, or terminal constraints.
The source changes vertical hierarchy and peak alignment, not spacing or kerning between letters.
The geometric alignment refinement does not change the deferred champagne material treatment or its role.
The source provides design feedback but does not change the obligation to include rationale with review rounds.
The source contains no decision about proof attachment formats or Mac viewability.
